title: Synergy Area with FDR-controlled Evaluation (SAFE) to robustly assess safety profile in clinical trials
summary: Safety assessment plays a fundamental role in developing a new drug via clinical trials for ethical considerations. Due to complexity, manual review is typically conducted on the totality of data to draw safety conclusions. There are some existing quantitative methods to facilitate or tailor further medical review, with a controlled error rate and integration of clinical knowledge. In addition to those two key aspects, we emphasize the importance of relying on substantial evidence to draw robust conclusions on safety. Motivated by these three important properties, we propose a two-layer Synergy Area with FDR-controlled Evaluation (SAFE) structural framework to robustly assess the safety profile in clinical trials. In the first layer of SAFE, we investigate each clinically meaningful Synergy Area (SA) based on compelling evidence. In the next layer, the false discovery rate (FDR) is controlled for potential findings across all SAs. Simulation studies show that SAFE properly controls error rates within and across SAs at the nominal level. We further apply the proposed approach to two case studies based on real data from the Historical Trial Data (HTD) Sharing Initiative of the DataCelerate platform. As compared to some direct methods, SAFE demonstrates an appealing feature of screening out extreme data and reaching solid safety conclusions. It can act as either a building block in another framework, or a platform to incorporate additional components.

title: Evaluating the probative value of forensic gait analysis evidence using empirical data
summary: Forensic gait analysis can aid the investigation of crimes through comparing features of gait captured in video footage. Modelling the probative value of gait evidence requires an understanding of the variation of features of gait between individuals in the population and within the same individuals. We address this question using a previously described population dataset and newly collected datasets with repeated observations of the same individuals on separate occasions. In addition to exploring the level of variability, correlation between features of gait, and the effect of demographic factors, we developed a likelihood ratio model through recoding features of gait as dichotomous variables and dimension reduction using PCA. High correlations between some features were observed, confirming that they should not contribute independently to the weight of evidence. The likelihood ratio model produced misleading likelihood ratios in less than 10% of the comparisons using the first four principal components. However, the risk increases when within-individual variability is mis-specified. Therefore, while the current model provides assistance to the judgement of gait experts, human expertise is indispensable to decide whether or not the difference in walking and/or recording conditions between the reference and questioned footage could have caused any observed differences in the features of gait. We discuss future directions in understanding the sources of the variability, improving statistical modelling and note the need to consider carefully how to select the relevant population for model fitting.

title: Statistical analysis of virion-cell interactions mediated by peptide nanofibrils and peptide amphiphiles using STEM tomography
summary: Peptide nanofibrils (PNFs) and peptide amphiphiles (PAs) are promising tools for enhancing viral transduction and gene transfer. However, quantitative insight into how their supramolecular architecture governs virion-cell interactions is limited. Here, we introduce a framework for the acquisition, processing, and statistical analysis of scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) tomograms to objectively quantify peptide-virion-cell interactions. Using four transduction-enhancing peptides (D4, Vectofusin-1, palmitic acid-PA (pal-PA), and eicosapentaenoic-PA (eic-PA)), peptide aggregate morphology, interfacial contact areas, and the spatial organization of virions with respect to peptides and cells were analyzed using advanced geometric descriptors. All peptides efficiently captured virions, resulting in few free virions, but they differ in how strictly virions were spatially confined near the cell surface. These differences reflect alternative spatial organization strategies, which are likely crucial factors influencing transduction-enhancing efficacy. Our approach provides a novel, generalizable method to evaluate infection-enhancing nanomaterials and guides the rational design of next-generation peptide assemblies for therapeutic viral delivery.

AI.title_translation: 使用STEM断层扫描技术统计分析由肽纳米纤维和肽两亲分子介导的病毒-细胞相互作用
AI.tldr: 研究通过STEM成像和统计分析，揭示了肽类纳米材料通过不同空间组织策略增强病毒转导的机制，为病毒递送载体的理性设计提供了定量评估方法。
AI.motivation: 肽纳米纤维和肽两亲分子在增强病毒转导方面表现出潜力，但目前缺乏关于其超分子结构如何具体调控病毒与细胞相互作用的定量研究。
AI.method: 利用扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）断层扫描技术，结合先进的几何描述符，对四种肽类材料（D4, Vectofusin-1, pal-PA, eic-PA）的聚集形态、界面接触面积以及病毒在细胞表面的空间组织进行了量化统计分析。
AI.result: 所有测试肽类均能有效捕获病毒，但它们在将病毒空间限制在细胞表面附近的能力上存在显著差异，表明不同肽类采用不同的空间组织策略来影响转导效率。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了一套量化肽类纳米材料与病毒-细胞相互作用的分析框架，揭示了不同自组装结构在病毒空间限制策略上的差异，为未来高效病毒载体的理性设计提供了重要参考。
AI.translation: 肽纳米纤维（PNFs）和肽两亲分子（PAs）是增强病毒转导和基因转移的有前景的工具。然而，关于它们的超分子结构如何调控病毒-细胞相互作用的定量见解仍然有限。在此，我们引入了一个用于扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）断层扫描图像采集、处理和统计分析的框架，以客观量化肽-病毒-细胞相互作用。通过使用四种转导增强肽（D4、Vectofusin-1、棕榈酸-PA（pal-PA）和二十碳五烯酸-PA（eic-PA）），我们利用先进的几何描述符分析了肽聚集体形态、界面接触面积以及病毒相对于肽和细胞的空间组织。所有肽都能有效地捕获病毒，导致游离病毒很少，但它们在病毒在细胞表面附近的空间受限程度方面存在差异。这些差异反映了不同的空间组织策略，这可能是影响转导增强功效的关键因素。我们的方法提供了一种新颖且可推广的方法来评估感染增强纳米材料，并指导用于治疗性病毒递送的下一代肽组装体的理性设计。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于STEM断层扫描的定量分析框架，用于评估肽类纳米材料增强病毒转导的机制。研究通过对比四种肽类材料，发现尽管它们都能有效捕获病毒，但在病毒的空间分布策略上表现出差异，为设计更高效的病毒递送纳米材料提供了新的评估手段。
AI.keywords: 肽纳米纤维, 肽两亲分子, STEM断层扫描, 病毒转导, 空间组织分析
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入STEM断层扫描定量分析框架，填补了纳米材料与病毒相互作用机制研究中的量化空白。其创新之处在于将复杂的几何描述符应用于病毒-细胞交互界面，对于优化基因治疗载体具有重要指导意义，但研究仅限于体外观察，未涉及体内实际转导效率的动力学验证。

title: The Catastrophic Consequences of Agnosticism for Life Searches and a Possible Workaround
summary: Planned and ongoing searches for life, both biological and technological, confront an epistemic barrier concerning false positives - namely, that we don't know what we don't know. The most defensible and agnostic approach is to adopt diffuse (uninformative) priors, not only for the prevalence of life, but also for the prevalence of confounders. We evaluate the resulting Bayes factors between the null and life hypotheses for an idealized experiment with $N_{pos}$ positive labels (biosignature detections) among $N_{tot}$ targets with various priors. Using diffuse priors, the consequences are catastrophic for life detection, requiring at least ${\sim}10^4$ (for some priors ${\sim}10^{13}$) surveyed targets to ever obtain "strong evidence" for life. Accordingly, an HWO-scale survey with $N_{tot}{\sim}25$ would have no prospect of achieving this goal. A previously suggested workaround is to forgo the agnostic confounder prior, by asserting some upper limit on it for example, but we find that the results can be highly sensitive to this choice - as well as difficult to justify. Instead, we suggest a novel solution that retains agnosticism: by dividing the sample into two groups for which the prevalence of life differs, but the confounder rate is global. We show that a $N_{tot}=24$ survey could expect 24% of possible outcomes to produce strong life detections with this strategy, rising to $\geq50$% for $N_{tot}\geq76$. However, AB-testing introduces its own unique challenges to survey design, requiring two groups with differing life prevalence rates (ideally greatly so) but a global confounder rate.

AI.title_translation: 不可知论对生命搜寻的灾难性后果及一种可能的解决方案
AI.tldr: 在生命搜寻中，对干扰因素持完全“不可知”态度会导致探测结果失效；作者提出通过AB测试（对比不同生命分布的样本组）来绕过这一统计障碍，从而提高探测任务的成功率。
AI.motivation: 解决在生命搜寻中，由于对干扰因素缺乏先验知识（不可知论）而导致探测任务极难获得显著统计证据的困境。
AI.method: 通过贝叶斯因子分析评估不同先验对生命探测的影响，并提出一种将样本分为两组（生命先验概率不同但干扰率全局一致）的AB测试方法，以提高探测的统计显著性。
AI.result: 使用传统的扩散（无信息）先验，现有规模的探测任务（如HWO）几乎无法获得强证据；而采用作者提出的AB测试策略，即使是小规模样本（如N=24），也有望显著提高获得强证据的概率。
AI.conclusion: 在寻找生命的过程中，传统的不可知论先验会导致探测效率极低。通过采用AB测试策略，即对比不同生命先验概率但拥有全局干扰率的样本组，可以在不牺牲不可知论的前提下，显著提高探测到生命的确凿性。
AI.translation: 计划中和正在进行的生物及技术生命搜寻项目，面临着一个关于假阳性的认知障碍——即我们不知道自己不知道什么。最可辩护且不可知的做法是采用扩散（无信息）先验，这不仅针对生命的普遍性，也针对干扰因素的普遍性。我们评估了一个理想化实验中，在 $N_{tot}$ 个目标中出现 $N_{pos}$ 个正标签（生物特征探测）时，零假设与生命假设之间的贝叶斯因子。使用扩散先验，其对生命探测的后果是灾难性的，需要至少约 $10^4$（对于某些先验甚至约 $10^{13}$）个目标才能获得生命的“强证据”。因此，规模为 $N_{tot} \approx 25$ 的 HWO 级调查将无法实现这一目标。一种建议的权宜之计是放弃不可知的干扰先验，例如断言其上限，但我们发现结果对此选择高度敏感，且难以证明其合理性。相反，我们提出了一种保留不可知论的新方案：将样本分为两组，这两组的生命普遍性不同，但干扰率是全局的。我们证明，采用这种策略，一个 $N_{tot}=24$ 的调查预期有 24% 的可能结果产生强生命探测，当 $N_{tot} \geq 76$ 时，该比例升至 $\geq 50\%$。然而，AB测试为调查设计带来了独特的挑战，需要两组具有不同生命普遍性（理想情况下差异巨大）但具有全局干扰率的样本。
AI.summary: 论文探讨了在生命搜寻中因对干扰因素持“不可知论”态度而导致的统计学困境。研究发现，传统的无信息先验使得探测任务极其低效。为此，作者提出了一种基于AB测试的新策略，通过比较不同生命先验概率的样本组，有效提升了在保持不可知论前提下获得确凿生命证据的可行性。
AI.keywords: 生命搜寻, 贝叶斯推断, 假阳性, 不可知论, AB测试
AI.comments: 该论文揭示了在寻找外星生命时，如果对干扰因素（假阳性来源）采取过于保守的“不可知论”先验，会导致贝叶斯因子失效，使得探测任务几乎不可能获得确凿证据。作者提出的AB测试方案巧妙地在保持不可知论的同时，通过对比不同生命概率的样本组来绕过这一障碍，为未来如HWO（宜居世界天文台）等任务提供了重要的策略参考。该方法的局限在于需要预先了解或假设样本组之间生命分布的差异。

title: Tweedie-based nonparametric estimation for semicontinuous mixed densities
summary: Semicontinuous outcomes occur frequently in health services, insurance, and cost studies. Standard nonparametric density estimators are not well suited to such data because they do not naturally accommodate the mixed structure, the nonnegative support, or the pronounced boundary effects near zero. To address these limitations, we introduce an asymmetric kernel estimator for mixed densities on $[0,\infty)$ based on the Tweedie distribution. For a power parameter $p\in(1,2)$, the Tweedie kernel itself has a point mass at zero and an absolutely continuous component on $(0,\infty)$, yielding a unified smoothing construction that preserves the atom at zero and smooths the positive component using the full semicontinuous sample. We establish pointwise bias and variance expansions, derive asymptotic formulae for the mean squared error and mean integrated squared error, obtain optimal bandwidth rates, and prove asymptotic normality. We propose a profile least-squares cross-validation procedure to jointly select the bandwidth and the power parameter. Simulation results show competitive performance, particularly in challenging boundary-spike and heavy-tailed settings, and an application to emergency department length-of-stay data illustrates the practical value of the method.

AI.title_translation: 基于Tweedie的半连续混合密度非参数估计
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型的基于Tweedie分布的核估计器，能够有效处理半连续数据中的零点原子和边界效应，优于传统非参数方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的标准非参数密度估计器无法很好地处理半连续数据（如医疗健康数据中的成本或时长），难以自然地适应混合结构、非负支持集以及零点附近的显著边界效应。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于Tweedie分布的非对称核估计器，该估计器在零点处保留点质量，并对正值分量进行平滑处理；同时设计了一种轮廓最小二乘交叉验证过程用于联合选择带宽和幂参数。
AI.result: 通过理论分析建立了该估计器的偏差、方差、均方误差渐近公式及渐近正态性，并证明了最优带宽速率。模拟实验表明该方法在边界尖峰和重尾分布设定下表现优异，且在急诊住院时间数据的实际应用中效果良好。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的基于Tweedie分布的非参数核估计方法为处理半连续数据提供了一种统一且有效的框架，在理论上具备良好的渐近性质，在模拟和实际应用中展现出优于传统方法的性能。
AI.translation: 半连续结果常出现在医疗服务、保险和成本研究中。标准的非参数密度估计器并不适合此类数据，因为它们无法自然地适应混合结构、非负支持集或零点附近的显著边界效应。为了解决这些局限性，我们引入了一种基于Tweedie分布的$[0,\infty)$上混合密度的非对称核估计器。对于幂参数$p\in(1,2)$，Tweedie核本身在零点处具有点质量，在$(0,\infty)$上具有绝对连续分量，从而产生了一种统一的平滑结构，既保留了零点的原子，又利用完整的半连续样本平滑了正值分量。我们建立了逐点偏差和方差展开，推导了均方误差和均方积分误差的渐近公式，获得了最优带宽速率，并证明了其渐近正态性。我们提出了一种轮廓最小二乘交叉验证过程来联合选择带宽和幂参数。模拟结果显示了其具有竞争力的性能，特别是在具有挑战性的边界尖峰和重尾设置中，且对急诊科住院时间数据的应用说明了该方法的实际价值。
AI.summary: 本文针对半连续数据难以使用传统非参数密度估计器处理的问题，提出了一种基于Tweedie分布的非对称核估计方法。该方法通过统一的平滑架构，同时处理零点处的点质量与正值区间的连续分布，并通过轮廓最小二乘交叉验证实现参数优化，在处理边界效应和复杂分布时表现出显著的优越性。
AI.keywords: 半连续数据, Tweedie分布, 非对称核估计, 密度估计, 带宽选择
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入Tweedie分布构建非对称核估计器，巧妙地解决了半连续数据在零点处的点质量和正值区间的平滑问题。其创新点在于统一了零点原子和平滑正值分量，有效克服了传统核密度估计在处理非负、边界效应显著数据时的不足。该方法在处理极端值和边界分布方面具有显著优势。

title: On Model-Based Clustering With Entropic Optimal Transport
comments: This paper extends and substantially revises the preliminary results in [arXiv:2006.16548]
summary: We develop a new methodology for model-based clustering. Optimizing the log-likelihood provides a principled statistical framework for clustering, with solutions found via the EM algorithm. However, because the log-likelihood is nonconvex, only convergence to stationary points can be guaranteed, and practitioners often use multiple starting points in the hope that one will converge to the global solution. We consider a new loss function based on entropic optimal transport that shares the same global optimum as the log-likelihood but has a much better-behaved landscape, thereby avoiding spurious local-optima configurations that are pervasive with the log-likelihood. Similar to the EM algorithm for the log-likelihood, this new loss can be optimized by the Sinkhorn-EM algorithm, which we show converges at a rate comparable to that of EM. By analyzing extensive numerical experiments and two real-world applications in image segmentation in C. elegans microscopy and clustering in spatial transcriptomics, we show that this new loss outperforms log-likelihood optimization, indicating that it represents a valuable clustering methodology for practitioners.
comment: This paper extends and substantially revises the preliminary results in [arXiv:2006.16548]

AI.title_translation: 关于基于熵最优传输的模型聚类研究
AI.tldr: 提出了一种利用熵最优传输改进模型聚类的方法，通过Sinkhorn-EM算法有效克服了传统极大似然估计容易陷入局部最优的问题。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于极大似然的模型聚类方法依赖于EM算法，但由于目标函数是非凸的，容易陷入局部最优，导致聚类效果不稳定。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于熵最优传输的新损失函数，并设计了相应的Sinkhorn-EM算法进行优化。该方法通过优化损失函数的景观，使其比传统的极大似然目标函数更平滑，从而更容易找到全局最优解。
AI.result: 数值实验及在秀丽隐杆线虫显微图像分割和空间转录组聚类中的应用表明，该方法在性能上优于传统的极大似然优化方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于熵最优传输的Sinkhorn-EM算法是一种稳健且高效的聚类方法，在处理复杂数据分布时表现优于传统的极大似然估计。
AI.translation: 我们开发了一种模型聚类的新方法。优化对数似然为聚类提供了一个原则性的统计框架，其解通常通过EM算法求得。然而，由于对数似然函数是非凸的，只能保证收敛到驻点，从业者通常需要使用多个起始点以期收敛到全局最优解。我们考虑了一种基于熵最优传输的新损失函数，它与对数似然具有相同的全局最优值，但具有表现更好的优化景观，从而避免了对数似然中普遍存在的伪局部最优配置。类似于对数似然的EM算法，这种新损失可以通过Sinkhorn-EM算法进行优化，我们证明其收敛速度与EM相当。通过分析大量的数值实验以及在秀丽隐杆线虫显微图像分割和空间转录组聚类中的两个实际应用，我们证明这种新损失优于对数似然优化，表明它是一种对从业者有价值的聚类方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于熵最优传输的模型聚类新方法。通过引入具有更优优化景观的损失函数，该方法有效规避了传统极大似然估计中常见的局部最优陷阱，并利用Sinkhorn-EM算法实现了高效求解。在多项实验和实际应用中，该方法展现出比传统EM算法更好的聚类性能。
AI.keywords: 模型聚类, 熵最优传输, Sinkhorn-EM算法, 极大似然, 优化景观
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入熵正则化最优传输（Entropic Optimal Transport）来重塑聚类问题，巧妙地将非凸的极大似然目标函数转化为一个具有更好优化特性的损失函数。这种方法在保留聚类统计本质的同时，有效缓解了EM算法中常见的局部最优问题，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Dynamic Inference in Term Structure Models with Unspanned Latent Risks
comments: arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2204.10658
summary: We propose a parsimonious class of arbitrage-free, yields-only dynamic term structure models (DTSMs) with unspanned latent risks. To enable sequential estimation and forecasting, we develop a Sequential Monte Carlo framework that combines particle learning for static parameters with Kalman filter updates for latent states, yielding joint posterior inference and predictive distributions that account for both parameter and state uncertainty. We use this framework to assess the out-of-sample statistical and economic value of bond return predictability from the perspective of a Bayesian investor. Empirically, we find that unspanned latent factors contain predictive information beyond that embedded in the yield curve, improving out-of-sample forecasting performance relative to standard benchmark models. These gains translate into economically meaningful utility improvements across a range of portfolio settings. Finally, we show that the hidden component of the slope-related risk factor is countercyclical and associated with real economic activity, suggesting that the latent factors capture economically relevant variation not directly reflected in yields.

title: Quantifying the limits of human athletic performance: A Bayesian analysis of elite decathletes
summary: Because the decathlon tests many facets of athleticism, including sprinting, throwing, jumping, and endurance, many consider it to be the ultimate test of athletic ability. On this view, estimating the maximal decathlon score and understanding what it would take to achieve that score provides insight into the upper limits of human athletic potential. To this end, we develop a Bayesian composition model for forecasting how individual decathletes perform in each of the 10 decathlon events of time. Besides capturing potential non-linear temporal trends in performance, our model carefully captures the dependence between performance in an event and all preceding events. Using our model, we can simulate and evaluate the distribution of the maximal possible scores and identify profiles of decathletes who could realistically attain scores approaching this limit.

AI.title_translation: 量化人类运动表现的极限：对精英十项全能运动员的贝叶斯分析
AI.tldr: 研究人员利用贝叶斯模型分析十项全能表现，量化了人类运动能力的理论上限，并识别出实现该极限的运动员特征。
AI.motivation: 十项全能被视为衡量运动能力的终极指标，作者旨在通过量化十项全能的最高得分，深入探索人类运动潜能的上限。
AI.method: 开发了一种贝叶斯组合模型，用于预测十项全能运动员在各项比赛中的表现，该模型考虑了非线性时间趋势以及各比赛项目之间的依赖关系，并据此进行模拟以评估最高得分的分布。
AI.result: 模型能够成功模拟和评估十项全能最高可能得分的分布，并识别出那些能够现实地达到接近该极限得分的运动员特征。
AI.conclusion: 通过贝叶斯模型模拟，研究成功量化了人类十项全能的理论最高得分极限，并勾勒出了接近该极限的运动员特征画像，为理解人类运动潜能提供了定量依据。
AI.translation: 由于十项全能测试了运动能力的多个方面，包括短跑、投掷、跳跃和耐力，许多人将其视为运动能力的终极测试。基于这一观点，估算十项全能的最高得分并理解实现该得分所需的条件，可以深入了解人类运动潜能的上限。为此，我们开发了一种贝叶斯组合模型，用于预测个体十项全能运动员在十项比赛中随时间的变化表现。我们的模型不仅捕捉了表现中潜在的非线性时间趋势，还仔细捕捉了某项比赛表现与所有先前比赛表现之间的依赖关系。利用我们的模型，我们可以模拟和评估最高可能得分的分布，并识别出那些能够现实地达到接近这一极限的运动员特征。
AI.summary: 本研究开发了一种贝叶斯组合模型，通过分析十项全能运动员在各项比赛中的表现趋势及其内在依赖性，成功量化了人类在该项目中的运动潜能极限，并模拟了达成这一极限的运动员配置。
AI.keywords: 十项全能, 贝叶斯分析, 运动表现极限, 预测模型, 人类潜能
AI.comments: 该研究通过创新的贝叶斯组合模型，将单一运动表现的预测扩展到全能运动领域，不仅考虑了时间趋势，还巧妙地纳入了各项目间的依赖关系。其局限性在于未提及除生理表现外的外部环境因素对运动员成绩的具体影响。

title: Novel g-computation algorithms for time-varying actions with recurrent and semi-competing events
summary:
Background: A core aspect of epidemiology is determining the impacts of potential public health interventions over time. With long follow-up periods, epidemiologists may need to consider semi-competing events, in which a terminal event, like death, precludes a non-terminal event, like hypertension. Time-varying confounding poses an additional challenge when studying time-varying interventions or actions. Existing methods do not simultaneously address semi- competing events and time-varying confounding.
  Methods: We propose two novel g-computation algorithms for causal effects with semi- competing events and time-varying actions. To explore performance of our novel g-computation estimators, we conducted a Monte Carlo simulation study. We then applied our estimator to investigate how cigarette smoking prevention throughout young and middle adulthood might impact prevalent hypertension using data from Waves III (aged 18-26 years) - VI (aged 39-51 years) of the National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent to Adult Health.
  Results: Our simulations show that the novel g-computation estimators had little bias and appropriate confidence interval coverage. They outperformed existing alternative estimators across sample sizes. In the illustrative application, the novel estimator identified a small reduction in prevalence of hypertension and risk of death in midlife had all cigarette smoking been prevented across follow-up compared to the observed smoking patterns.
  Conclusion: As long-running cohorts progress in age, death within the study sample will become an increasing concern for studies of aging-related outcomes, life course analyses, and investigations into chronic disease development. Our novel g-computation estimators provide a simultaneous solution.

title: Market-implied time to transition to a low-carbon economy: a stochastic modelling and inference framework
summary: This paper introduces a new market-implied object, Time to Transition (TtT), extracted from the difference between two selected nodes of the greenium term structure. TtT is defined as the latent waiting time until this cross-maturity greenium difference vanishes, meaning that the greenium becomes equal across the two selected maturities. We develop an inference theory for this object. To model TtT, we introduce two tractable stochastic frameworks: the Regulatory Deadline-Constrained Model, in which the transition date is fixed, and a switching extension, in which alternative transition dates capture heterogeneous perceived deadlines across economic agents. The paper combines two layers of analysis. On a fixed daily grid, a deadline-constrained diffusion provides a tractable benchmark through an exact Gaussian bridge likelihood, while the switching extension preserves tractability through regime-specific bridge densities and filtering recursions. Under a fixed-horizon infill scheme, the same framework yields a structural identification result for the regime-wise diffusion parameters, with full or partial consistency depending on the observed region. The paper therefore contributes both a new inferential object, market-implied transition timing based on cross-maturity differences in the greenium term structure, and a two-layer inference framework: finite-sample filtering provides an operational monitoring tool, while fixed-horizon infill asymptotics specify when the regime-wise diffusion parameters carrying information about competing transition dates can be consistently estimated.

title: Scaling Limits of Bivariate Nearly-Unstable Hawkes Processes and Applications to Rough Volatility
summary:
We prove a functional limit theorem for a pair of nearly unstable Hawkes processes coupled through a triangular cross-excitation mechanism, when the two kernels have distinct heavy-tail exponents. This heterogeneous regime produces two different degrees of roughness and, to the best of our knowledge, had not previously been treated in the multivariate nearly unstable setting.
  As the system approaches criticality, the renormalized intensity processes converge weakly to the unique solution of a coupled stochastic Volterra system driven by two independent Brownian motions. The first component evolves autonomously as a rough fractional diffusion, while the second is driven both by its own noise and by the first component through a convolution cross-kernel. This kernel, expressed as the convolution of the two associated Mittag-Leffler kernels, encodes both roughness exponents and distinguishes the limit from independent univariate limits or classical bivariate Brownian models.
  We also derive a short-time decorrelation result showing that the functional correlation between the two limiting components vanishes at an explicit polynomial rate governed by the rougher component. Finally, we show that the scale-matching assumption is not structural: without it, the limiting cross-kernel is replaced by an explicitly time-rescaled convolution kernel. The proof combines kernel convergence, tightness, martingale identification via Rebolledo's theorem, and uniqueness for affine stochastic Volterra equations.

AI.title_translation: 二元近临界Hawkes过程的尺度极限及其在粗糙波动率中的应用
AI.tldr: 本文推导了具有不同重尾指数的二元近临界Hawkes过程的函数极限，证明其收敛于耦合的随机Volterra系统，并刻画了资产间粗糙波动率的非对称传递机制。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注单变量或同质Hawkes过程，缺乏对具有不同重尾指数（即不同粗糙度）的二元近临界Hawkes过程耦合机制的理论探讨。
AI.method: 利用核收敛、紧致性分析、基于Rebolledo定理的鞅识别以及仿射随机Volterra方程的唯一性证明。
AI.result: 证明了强度过程收敛于耦合的随机Volterra系统；推导了由较粗糙成分决定的短时去相关结果；明确了当尺度匹配假设失效时，极限交叉核表现为时间重缩放的卷积核。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了具有不同重尾指数的二元近临界Hawkes过程在临界状态下收敛于耦合的随机Volterra系统，揭示了粗糙度如何通过卷积核在跨资产间传递。
AI.translation: 我们证明了一对通过三角交叉激励机制耦合的近临界Hawkes过程的函数极限定理，其中两个核具有不同的重尾指数。这种异质机制产生了两种不同程度的粗糙度，据我们所知，此前在多变量近临界设定下尚未被处理。随着系统趋于临界状态，重归一化的强度过程弱收敛于由两个独立布朗运动驱动的耦合随机Volterra系统的唯一解。第一个分量作为粗糙分数扩散自主演化，而第二个分量不仅由其自身噪声驱动，还通过卷积交叉核由第一个分量驱动。该核表示为两个相关Mittag-Leffler核的卷积，它编码了两个粗糙度指数，并将该极限与独立的单变量极限或经典的二元布朗模型区分开来。我们还导出了一个短时去相关结果，表明两个极限分量之间的函数相关性以由较粗糙分量决定的明确多项式速率消失。最后，我们证明了尺度匹配假设不是结构性的：如果没有它，极限交叉核将被明确的时间重缩放卷积核所取代。证明结合了核收敛、紧致性、通过Rebolledo定理进行的鞅识别以及仿射随机Volterra方程的唯一性。
AI.summary: 本文研究了一对具有不同重尾指数的二元近临界Hawkes过程。作者证明了在临界状态下，该系统收敛于一个由独立布朗运动驱动的耦合随机Volterra方程组，其交叉依赖项由两个Mittag-Leffler核的卷积定义，并分析了其去相关特性及尺度匹配的影响。
AI.keywords: Hawkes过程, 粗糙波动率, 随机Volterra方程, 弱收敛, 临界状态
AI.comments: 该研究填补了多变量近临界Hawkes过程在异质重尾指数下的理论空白，为理解金融市场中不同资产间的粗糙波动率耦合提供了严谨的数学框架。其创新点在于通过卷积Mittag-Leffler核精确刻画了跨资产的非对称依赖关系。

title: Exact simulation scheme for the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck driven stochastic volatility model with the Karhunen-Loève expansions
summary: This study proposes a fast exact simulation scheme for the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck driven stochastic volatility model. With the Karhunen-Loève expansions, the stochastic volatility path (Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process) is expressed as a sine series, and the time integrals of volatility and variance are analytically derived as infinite series of independent normal random variables. The new method is several hundred times faster than the existing method using numerical transform inversion. The simulation variance is further reduced with conditional simulation and the control variate.

AI.title_translation: 基于Karhunen-Loève展开的Ornstein-Uhlenbeck驱动随机波动率模型的精确仿真方案
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用Karhunen-Loève展开进行随机波动率模型仿真的新方法，计算速度较传统方法提升了数百倍。
AI.motivation: 针对现有基于数值变换反演的随机波动率模型仿真方法计算效率较低的问题，寻求一种更快、更精确的仿真方案。
AI.method: 利用Karhunen-Loève展开将Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程表示为正弦级数，通过解析推导得到波动率和方差的时间积分，并结合条件模拟和控制变量法进行方差缩减。
AI.result: 该方法比现有的数值变换反演法快数百倍，并通过条件模拟和控制变量法有效降低了仿真方差。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种高效、精确的随机波动率模型仿真方案，通过分析推导显著提升了计算速度，并结合方差缩减技术进一步优化了模拟效果。
AI.translation: 本研究为Ornstein-Uhlenbeck驱动的随机波动率模型提出了一种快速精确的仿真方案。利用Karhunen-Loève展开，将随机波动率路径（Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程）表示为正弦级数，并解析导出了波动率和方差的时间积分，将其表达为独立正态随机变量的无穷级数。该新方法比现有的使用数值变换反演的方法快数百倍。此外，通过条件模拟和控制变量法进一步降低了仿真方差。
AI.summary: 本文为Ornstein-Uhlenbeck驱动的随机波动率模型提出了一种快速精确的仿真方案。利用Karhunen-Loève展开将波动率路径表示为正弦级数，实现了积分的解析表达，显著提升了计算速度并降低了模拟方差。
AI.keywords: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程, 随机波动率, Karhunen-Loève展开, 精确仿真, 计算金融
AI.comments: 该论文通过卡尔胡恩-洛伊夫（Karhunen-Loève）展开技术，将复杂的随机波动率过程转化为易于计算的级数形式，极大地提升了仿真效率。这一方法在计算金融领域具有重要应用价值，尤其是在需要高精度和高速度的蒙特卡洛模拟场景中。其主要局限性在于该方法可能更适用于特定的Ornstein-Uhlenbeck驱动模型，对于更复杂的波动率过程的适用性未在摘要中提及。
